title: PixelCast client configuration
description: Contract of pixelcast.yaml. API keys are never written here, they are read from the environment.

syncs.description: Sync groups, keyed by sync type. Omitting a group is the same as disabling it.

deviceSleep.description: Hours during which the device turns its panel off. Pushed on demand by `bin/console app:device:sleep`, never by the scheduler, so the section has no effect until that command has run. Without it the device keeps whatever schedule it already holds.

enabled.description: Master toggle of the schedule on the device. A disabled schedule leaves the panel on.

displayMode.description: What the panel shows while asleep. "black" blanks it, "clock" leaves a dimmed clock. Without it the panel is blanked.

days.description: Days the panel goes off. Without it every day is covered. A day left out is sent to the device with no window at all, so it clears whatever that day held.

windows.description: Stretches of the day the panel stays off, the same for every declared day. The firmware takes at most two per day.

from.description: Time the panel goes off, as HH:MM.

to.description: Time the panel comes back on, as HH:MM. A "to" earlier than "from" runs past midnight into the next day, the opposite of activeWindow.to, which refuses it.

weatherSync.description: Weather forecast pushed to the device.

enabled.description: A disabled group is never scheduled and cannot be dispatched by hand.

interval.description: How often the group runs, e.g. "30 minutes", "1 hour", "PT30M", "1800". At least 60 seconds.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location the forecast is fetched for.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location the forecast is fetched for.

locale.description: Locale used for the 3-letter forecast day labels.

staleBehavior.description: What the device does with the app once stale. "hide" falls back to the clock until the next push, "none" keeps showing the last forecast. Without it the firmware default applies.

trackerSync.description: Assets fetched in one batch from a single provider.

enabled.description: A disabled group is never scheduled and cannot be dispatched by hand.

interval.description: How often the group runs, e.g. "30 minutes", "1 hour", "PT30M", "1800". At least 60 seconds.

staleBehavior.description: What the device does with the app once stale. "hide" leaves the rotation until the next push, "dim" stays visible dimmed with a STALE badge, "badge" stays at full colour with the badge, "none" shows no sign. Without it the firmware default applies.

claudeSync.description: Claude Code subscription counters pushed as one gauge. The OAuth credentials are read from the file named by PIXELCAST_CLAUDE_CREDENTIALS_FILE, never from this file.

enabled.description: A disabled group is never scheduled and cannot be dispatched by hand.

interval.description: How often the group runs, e.g. "30 minutes", "1 hour", "PT30M", "1800". At least 60 seconds.

hiddenRows.description: Row labels left out of the gauge, as shown on the device ("5h", "7j", "fable", "credits"). A row named here is skipped even when the API answer carries it. Hiding every row leaves the group pushing nothing rather than an empty gauge. Without it every row the answer carries is shown.

staleBehavior.description: What the device does with the app once stale. "hide" leaves the rotation until the next push, "dim" stays visible dimmed with a STALE badge, "badge" stays at full colour with the badge, "none" shows no sign. Without it the firmware default applies.

staleAfter.description: Silence tolerated by the device before the app is considered stale, in seconds. 0 = never. Without it the value is three times the interval, the same rule the healthcheck applies.

activeWindow.description: Hours during which the group is scheduled and watched by the healthcheck. Without it the group runs around the clock.

days.description: Days the window is open. Without it every day is open.

from.description: Time the window opens, as HH:MM. Inclusive.

to.description: Time the window closes, as HH:MM. Inclusive, and strictly after "from": a window spanning midnight is not supported.

timezone.description: Timezone the two times are read in, e.g. "Europe/Paris". A market opens at a local hour, not at the hour of the container clock.

symbol.description: Identifier of the asset for this provider.

currency.description: Currency the asset price is quoted in.

icon.description: Identifier of the icon shown next to the asset on the device.

label.description: Text shown on the top row instead of the symbol derived from the provider identifier.

labelColor.description: Hex color of the label. Without it the label follows the trend color, like the sparkline.

bottomLine.description: What the row under the price shows when bottomText does not fix it. "ath" shows the all-time high of the asset, "volume" its 24 hour traded volume. Each group only accepts what it can serve: coingecko takes both, boursorama takes ath, twelvedata takes neither. Without it the group default applies: coingecko shows the volume, the other groups show nothing.

volumeBars.description: Whether the device draws the traded volume as bars behind the price curve. Enabled without it, and only where the provider serves a volume for each point of the curve. Turning it off for a coingecko asset also spares the extra request that provider needs to collect the series.

staleBehavior.description: What the device does with this asset once stale. "hide" leaves the rotation until the next push, "dim" stays visible dimmed with a STALE badge, "badge" stays at full colour with the badge, "none" shows no sign. Without it the value of the group applies.
